blocks.html:
Coyote Head Decals

Unless you are a Ford or even a Mustang enthusiast, you might not know about the Ford Coyote engine. They are used only for Mustang GTs and some F-150s currently being built. The customer had already put plenty of time and money into realizing his vision. When the Mustang first arrived, the crew was impressed with the level of detail the customer had already achieved. The green colour was carried through the interior of the car on the dashboard and interior lights. The before and after shows the impact the Coyote head decals add to the green Mustang.

When the client stopped by Vinyl Wrap Toronto’s garage, he explained his vision to pay homage to the Coyote engine. The customer worked with our design team to place coyote head decals on both sides of the vehicle. The decals were cut out of Avery Dennison Gloss Black to match the rest of the vehicle’s details.
Placement of the Coyote Head stickers on the Mustang was made easier by using pre-masking tape and the proofs sent to the client. While the Mustang was in the garage, the customer asked for us to add a strip of gloss black to the front bumper.
The customer was super happy with the decals on his Mustang and could not wait to show off the Coyote Head decals.

Speak to our installation team about your personalization ideas and dream at 416-746-1381 whether they are small decals, logos, or racing stripes. View more decals.
